import snowflake.snowpark as snowpark
import snowflake.snowpark.modin.plugin
import modin.pandas as pd
from   modin.pandas import DataFrame

def Script(session: snowpark.Session, in0: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
properties.script:
import pandas as pd

df = in0.copy()
group_cols = ["Store Number", "_group_id"]
pivot_col = "_position_id"
agg_dict = {"Units": "max", "_position_id": "max", "UnitCost": "max", "_sequence_id": "max", "_total_records": "max"}
col_to_alias = {"Units": "Units", "_position_id": "_position_id", "UnitCost": "UnitCost", "_sequence_id": "_sequence_id", "_total_records": "_total_records"}


df_pivoted = pd.pivot_table(
    df,
    index=group_cols,
    columns=pivot_col if pivot_col else None,
    values=list(agg_dict.keys()),
    aggfunc=agg_dict,
)

if col_to_alias:
    if isinstance(df_pivoted.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
        new_cols = []
        for i in range(len(df_pivoted.columns)):
            pivot_val = df_pivoted.columns.get_level_values(-1)[i]
            val_col = df_pivoted.columns.get_level_values(0)[i]
            alias = col_to_alias.get(val_col, val_col)
            new_cols.append(f"{pivot_val}_{alias}")
        df_pivoted.columns = new_cols
    else:
        alias = list(col_to_alias.values())[0] if col_to_alias else ""
        df_pivoted = df_pivoted.rename(columns={c: f"{c}_{alias}" for c in df_pivoted.columns})

df_pivoted = df_pivoted.reset_index()


return df_pivoted
